title: Binary Output Machine
statement: A finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet with no work tapes and one state is defined as follows: when it scans an input symbol, it moves the input head right, outputs $0$, and remains in its state; when it scans a blank, it outputs $1$ and halts.
hypotheses_covered: The alphabet is the binary alphabet
The machine has zero work tapes
